comment: Lines whose words changed after they had already been recorded.
`lines` is stamped onto assets/sfx/manifest.json as `needsRerecord` by
tools/rerecord-queue.mjs, which runs at the end of `npm run vo:sync`. It has
to live here rather than in the manifest because most of these cues are
generated -- a scene's *-vo.mjs rewrites its whole block, and a flag written
into the manifest by hand is silently dropped the next time anybody syncs.
`retired` is the other half of the same pass: cue ids under vo.bing.full.* and
vo.silver.* embed a hash of the line, so changing the words changes the id and
therefore the filename. Those need no flag -- the new id has no recording, so it
surfaces in VOICE-LINES-NEEDED.md on its own. They are listed for provenance,
and because their old takes were deleted as orphans.
`recast` is the third half: a PROFILE whose ElevenLabs id changed, rather than
a line whose words did. Nothing else in this repository can see one. The take
ledger stamps a voiceId only on takes it rendered itself, so a character whose
takes all predate it -- stamped "assumed", carrying no voice on purpose -- can
be recast in the manifest and keep shipping the old performer with every gate
green. That is not hypothetical: it is what happened to Rico, and it is the
case tests/motel-voice.test.mjs now refuses to let pass silently.
Remove an entry once `npm run sfx -- --force --cast <profile>` has re-rendered
the takes and `npm run vo:takes` has stamped them.
Remove a line from `lines` once its replacement take is indexed.

lines.retiredText: You have to actually pull on the strap. Tapping a strap tells you nothing.
lines.reason: the payload check moved from a strap tug to holding the arming key down in the 2026-08-20 flight pass; the indexed take teaches the wrong action. Found by tools/take-history.mjs on 2026-08-22, six days after the rewrite -- the same commit queued six other lines and missed this one

lines.retiredText: Number two’s running hot. Your call — babied throttle and a long way home, or push it and hope.
lines.reason: the overheat moved to engine three with a temperature readout in the 2026-08-20 flight pass; the indexed take names a DIFFERENT ENGINE from the subtitle in a scene where the player acts on which one is hot. Found by tools/take-history.mjs on 2026-08-22

lines.retiredText: You ate at mine. Four in the morning, corner two. You tipped Hector. Nobody tips Hector — he is behind a wall, you would have had to go and find him.
lines.reason: the tree opens this line on an ellipsis -- Margo picking the thought back up -- and the manifest row had never carried it, so the indexed take comes in flat on 'You ate at mine'. Found by the drift check tools/bing-vo.mjs gained for HAND-NAMED tree cues: the generator only ever minted, and only ever compared, the vo.bing.full. prefix, so ninety-nine rows had never been compared against the tree by anybody

retired.newText: What’s good back there that isn’t going to kill me?
I’ll write that on my hand.
Let’s start with money. Not names, money. Who paid you? how, and did it clear?

retired.retiredText: Why didn’t you tell us before?
retired.newText: That was available the entire time. Every minute of the last hour was elective. I hope you understand that’s a choice you made.
You still with us, Numbskull? Blink if the answer’s no.

retired.retiredText: Did you go through it properly?
retired.newText: Did you actually go through it, or did you look at it and get bored?
They’re alive, which this week counts.

retired.retiredText: You want to come back for a drink?
retired.newText: Come back with me. There’s a bottle I’ve been saving for a reason I couldn’t name until about an hour ago.

retired.retiredText: The night doesn’t have to end here.
retired.newText: I’m not ready for this to be over and I’m too old to pretend otherwise.
We’re looked after. Go be somewhere else for twenty minutes.

retired.retiredText: Same again, when you get a second.
retired.newText: Same again. And I’d like it to arrive before the conversation improves, not after.
